simple.meaning: חֶבֶל (chebel) appears 62 times in the Hebrew Scriptures and is introduced as a son in the family line and in connection with kingship.
simple.biblicalBackground: The first appearances are in Deuteronomy, Joshua, 1 Samuel, 2 Samuel, 1 Kings, and 14 more, beginning at Deuteronomy 3:4. BibleIQ detects the main surrounding context as family line, kingship, city, land.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to חֶבֶל (H2256) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: People in Scripture are understood by their place in the story. BibleIQ follows חֶבֶל through the actual verses so the reader sees the person in context instead of as an isolated dictionary entry.
simple.summary: חֶבֶל (chebel) / H2256 is tracked through Deuteronomy 3:4, Deuteronomy 3:13, Deuteronomy 3:14, Deuteronomy 32:9. The entry is generated from source alignment, occurrence evidence, and the surrounding Scripture context.
